metadata.summary: Comprehensive CDC source applicability, ordering, delete propagation, and privilege boundary matrix across all 15 internal MongoDB collections, 6 external providers, 2 weather/demographics live providers, and 8 declared contract models. Documents why batch/sensor polling currently satisfies downstream daily partition consumers and identifies technical requirements for potential future CDC streaming.
